prompt:
A desktop e-commerce homepage for First Nutrition, an official sports-supplement distributor in Jordan and Lebanon, rendered edge to edge as a finished website screen with crisp, readable text; no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor's job: pick a training goal and order the right supplements on WhatsApp, cash on delivery. What leads is a weightlifting competition platform seen from directly above, filling the first screen: chalk-dusted pale boards, painted white boundary lines, a loaded knurled barbell lying across it horizontally. Four bumper plates lie flat around the bar, seen from above as big circles with stencilled names; they are the goal buttons: BULK, CUT, BUILD MUSCLE, PERFORM. BUILD MUSCLE is the red one, selected. Standing on the platform next to the bar, the stack for that goal, seen from a high angle so labels read: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey 50 JOD, MuscleTech Platinum Creatine 28 JOD, Scivation Xtend 30 JOD, each with a small 'Official stock' ticket. Across the top of the platform runs a red competition scoreboard strip: 'GOAL: BUILD MUSCLE · STACK: 3 PRODUCTS · TOTAL: 108 JOD' with a button 'Order this stack on WhatsApp'. Headline in stencil caps on the platform: 'LOAD YOUR GOAL.' A line: 'Official distributor · 21 brands · ISO 9001 / 22000 / 45001 · Cash on delivery'.

Frame: the First Nutrition wordmark in red at top left, navigation Shop, Brands, Offers, Branches, About, a search field, a Jordan · JOD switch, an العربية language switch, and a cart.

Visual law: white and chalk-grey ground with competition red #ED312E as the only colour, used at plate scale. Plates are red or black rubber carrying only their goal name and kg number in white stencil; no manufacturer or brand names on plates or bar. Condensed industrial stencil numerals and caps as printed on real competition plates, a sturdy grotesk for body text. Photographic, bright daylight, not dark, not cartoon.
